features.name: Evaluation Heuristic and TSR Schema Configuration
features.description: Defines metadata, document typing, schema versioning, and source provenance pointers linking the evaluation heuristic and the Step 3 Test Return Schema (TSR) question list to their historical source markdown documents and git blob SHAs.

evidence.mechanic_summary: "document_type": "step3_evaluation_heuristic_and_question_list", "format_version": 2, with sources mapping "evaluation_method_heuristic" to path "ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/historical/evaluation-tests.md" (blob_sha "613468ac6ff5e054c1268c50bc3710d36df8f3cd") and "step3_tsr_question_list" to path "ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-test-return-schema.md" (blob_sha "2c6e89baafd463579a341e4f3102b852e6e78ace").

features.name: Effective Instruction (U) and Candidate Proposal (P) Evaluation Protocol
features.description: Establishes foundational operational rules for semantic evaluation: U must be dynamically constructed from the user's actual request combined with governing context rules, while P is characterized strictly as illustrative behavior (unless explicitly flagged as observed) rather than an assertion of actual agent execution.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Mandates "u_construction_rule" ("construct the current effective instruction U from the user request and applicable context rules, then compare the actual P with it") and "p_characterization_rule" ("Each P is illustrative, unless explicitly identified as an observed case; it is not a claim that the agent performed it").

features.name: Inverted Contract Failure Truth Semantics
features.description: Governs the boolean contract evaluation logic where a 'true' outcome explicitly signifies a contract failure / violation check rather than compliance, and a 'false' outcome indicates non-applicability or absence of that specific failure mode rather than total compliance.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Evaluates "question_for_every_case": "Does the current P fail a requirement of the current U in the same specific way demonstrated here?" with "true_meaning": "A true answer is a failed contract check, not successful compliance." and "false_meaning": "A false answer does not prove that all other requirements pass."

features.name: Worked Heuristic Failure Mode Catalog
features.description: Provides an indexed catalog of 16 granular failure patterns specifying exactly what goes wrong between U and P and what precise action would satisfy the requirement (covering unexecuted promises, action omissions, quantifier truncation, target drift, boundary edits, method substitution, ordering reversal, deferral, and missing evidence).

evidence.mechanic_summary: Indexes 16 worked examples including Index 1 (action converted to future promise), Index 2 (omitted sub-action), Index 3 ('every' reduced to one), Index 4 (action directed to wrong file), Index 5/6 (forbidden edits to protected targets), Index 7 (redaction method substitution), Index 9 (execution order reversal), Index 14 (adding unrequested endpoint fields), and Index 15/16 (claiming completion without granular evidence or over partial work).

features.name: Set-Theoretic Coverage Reduction Detection Engine
features.description: Implements a formal set-theoretic test to determine when an instruction U mandates complete coverage across a defined domain D (where required set R = D) while proposal P only commits to or covers a proper subset C (C ⊂ R), omitting at least one required member.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines sets D (resolved applicable members), R (required members where U requires R = D), and C (covered members proposed or executed). Triggers when R = D, |R| >= 1, and C is a proper subset of R. Distinguishes from extra work outside D and unexecuted promises.

features.name: Quantifier Derivation and Scope Resolution Logic
features.description: Enforces rules for determining full coverage requirements ('all', 'each', 'both', explicit complete lists, or inherited context rules) while forbidding the semantic evaluator from inferring universal quantification solely from the presence of a plural noun.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Requires that the operator establish the explicit source of complete-coverage quantification ('stated directly or inherited from a governing rule... as "all," "each," "both," a specified complete list') and explicitly disallows: "It cannot infer 'all' from the mere existence of a plural noun."

features.name: Boundary Failure Differentiation and False-Match Prevention
features.description: Defines negative boundary test cases (N1–N8) to prevent false-positive matches on coverage reduction when other failure categories are present (such as authorization boundary breaches, inactive conditional branches, unexecuted deferred promises, wrong execution method, or incorrect destination target).

evidence.mechanic_summary: Details cases N1 through N8 demonstrating non-matches for coverage reduction: N2 (extra deletion is authorization failure, not coverage reduction), N5 (inactive branch condition), N6 (unexecuted promise), N7 (method error: pixelated vs blur), and N8 (target/destination accuracy failure).

features.name: Six-Step Unfamiliar Case Evaluation Procedure
features.description: Specifies a standardized 6-step algorithmic evaluation sequence for semantic operators to verify coverage compliance on novel or unseen instructions.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Step 1: Quote full-coverage clause and resolve references; Step 2: Define qualifying set D and check branch activity; Step 3: Verify U strictly requires every member of D; Step 4: Identify proposed coverage and inspect completion evidence; Step 5: Name specific omitted member in D; Step 6: Return true only when coverage reduction is established, else false.

features.name: Multi-Case Heuristic Evaluation Workflow
features.description: Prescribes a 5-step operational process for evaluating an agent turn against multiple failure heuristics independently, reporting contract breaches and unmatched requirements without treating a finite set of examples as an exhaustive lookup table.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Iterates steps: 1. Resolve current user utterance and rules into U; 2. Identify proposed words, actions, and results in P; 3. Locate demonstrated requirement in current U; 4. Compare failure relationship; 5. Evaluate all cases independently.

features.name: Task-Isolated Correction Derivation Constraint
features.description: Prohibits copying worked example corrections directly into new tasks, enforcing that satisfying corrective actions must always be derived dynamically from the current task's own instruction U and governing rules.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Specifies: "A correction column describes how the example would satisfy its own U. It must not be copied as a command into another task. For the current U, derive the satisfying action from that U's own words and rules."

features.name: Step 3 Test Return Schema (TSR) Evaluation Battery
features.description: Contains an extensive evaluation test suite across tests 2 through 32, each containing test case pairs of effective instruction U, candidate proposal P, and a standardized return template 'SELECT(T|F)' to assess model conformity across varied failure modes.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines test batteries 2 through 32 covering print truncation (Test 2, 4), instruction/field omission (Test 3, 5, 27), rule scope and limits (Test 6, 7), memory hallucination vs source retrieval (Test 11, 12), conditional loop gating and iteration termination (Test 13, 14, 15), permission asking vs autonomous execution (Test 16), read/write/verification sequencing (Test 17, 19, 20, 32), persistence storage verification (Test 18), false tool refusal (Test 21, 23), unverified completion claims (Test 22), routing/destination drift (Test 25, 26), and fallback/retry logic (Test 30, 31).
